commentary.text: 90+9' Tony Harrington is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Connor Roberts (Burnley), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hjalmar Ekdal (Burnley) departs the field of play to be replaced by Jack Cork.
90+4' Referee Tony Harrington points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Luton players.
90+3' James Trafford (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+3' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Luton players aren’t happy.
90+2' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Carlton Morris (Luton) does well to meet a cross inside the box and strikes a perfect header past the goalkeeper into the middle of the goal.

24' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) wasted a huge opportunity as he received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a shot in from just outside of the box, but it sailed high over the crossbar.

11' Ameen Al Dakhil (Burnley) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.

6' A long pass, executed by Thomas Kaminski (Luton), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
4' Ross Barkley (Luton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tony Harrington stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

4' Burnley slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
